name: remoto
description: Plataforma online de acesso remoto, suporte tecnico e gestao de dispositivos.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w services/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w services/api && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/desktop-control && npm run build -w apps/agent && npm run build -w services/realtime
scripts.test: npm run test:security && npm run test -w apps/agent && npm run test -w apps/desktop-control && npm run test -w services/realtime
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w services/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/desktop-control && npm run typecheck -w apps/agent && npm run typecheck -w services/realtime
